g.text: Developers write code for new features or bug fixes.
This phase involves creating a roadmap, defining features, and estimating timelines.
The code is compiled and built into executable files or artifacts.
The software is deployed to a staging or production environment.
Continuous monitoring of applications and infrastructure is performed to identify performance issues, bugs, or security vulnerabilities.
Automated testing is conducted to ensure the code meets quality standards.
The application is deployed to production, making it accessible to end-users.
Operations teams monitor the application's performance and respond to issues.
